text:
mina: Idea: run a "mini-workshop" funnel for new signups. structure = 1) 15-min on-demand workshop video + 2) 15 starter credits + 3) a 3-prompt "challenge" (one each: embed, summarize, code-gen). Goal: increase meaningful usage within 48h.
maria: love it. workshop arrow: short, tactical, and actionable. prefer 15m over 30m so people actually watch.
ashley: creative lanes: "build" (dev-focused) and "ship" (product/ops copy). we should A/B the CTA phrasing.
jon: routing idea: capture "primary-goal" at signup (search/docs/chat/code) and surface the matching challenge prompt pack. minimal friction.
sam: ops constraints: credits expire in 7d, throttle new users 80rpm default. we need a safety cap on concurrent starter tasks to avoid model spikes.
mina: proposed cadence: 0h email w/ workshop link + credits + CTA, 6-12h in-app nudge + challenge card, 24h reminder w/ 30s highlight clip, 48h last-chance. compress to 48h window.
maria: metric targets: 35% first_challenge_attempt within 24h, 20% first_success, cost per activation <$0.75.
ashley: subject line candidates: "15-minute workshop + starter credits", "Try a 3-prompt challenge (15 min)". A/B top two.
jon: analytics keys: event names = workshop_sent, credits_granted, challenge_started, prompt_executed, first_success. wire model_name and variant in payload.
sam: infra checklist: create flag mini_workshop_v1, quota caps, alert if starter model latency > 2s or concurrent starter requests > 200.
mina: prompt pack rules: keep to 3 prompts, include a one-sentence expected outcome and a seed input. store as PromptPack-mini_2026_06 (immutable).
maria: deliverables: workshop script (15m), 30s clip for reminder, 3 prompt texts + seed inputs, email A/B. deadline: deliver by Wed EOD.
ashley: landing microcopy: "15m to a working result. use your 15 credits." add small expiration CTA.
jon: segmentation work: i'll add primary-goal to the signup and map to prompt packs. QA analytics keys.
sam: growth-bot: experiment created mini_workshop_v1 (id: exp_20260607_3). traffic: 8% initial, auto-ramp to 40% if no regressions in 72h. alerts set.
mina: runbook essentials: how to pause (disable credits flag), rollback steps, oncall contact (eng-runtime), and who owns follow-up emails (marketing).
maria: suggest we include an in-product countdown banner when credits are live to create urgency.
ashley: :white_check_mark: will mock that for UI.
mina: ok team. timeline: drafts by Wed, infra ready Thu AM, soft launch Fri 8am PT at 8% traffic. will post prompt pack drafts here for quick review.
